title: husband says FIVE STARS
text: husband says FIVE STARS. Bought this to go with the Kershaw knife I bought for my husband for his birthday.  He is very hard on his knives and I thought an easy to use sharpener would be nice... He is a traditionalist when it comes to sharpening, a stone and oil, so I wasn't sure this sharpener would work for him, but he LOVED it.. I watched him use it and in just a few seconds he had his older Kershaw blade sharp as new.  He was thrilled.
